topic: Capstone Presentation, Portfolio Case Study, and Design Documentation
learningObjectives: Present the capstone project using a clear UX case-study structure.
Document the design process, decisions, iterations, and outcomes.
Create a portfolio-ready project narrative and future improvement roadmap.

activities.title: Case Study Story Map
activities.instruction: Arrange the project stages into a clear UX case-study narrative.

content.concept: A UX case study connects the problem, research, design decisions, iterations, and outcome into a coherent narrative.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Presentation Structure
activities.instruction: Build a concise structure for the final project presentation.

content.concept: A strong design presentation communicates the problem, process, solution, evidence, and key learnings clearly.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Portfolio Evidence Selector
activities.instruction: Select artifacts that demonstrate the reasoning and evolution behind the final design.

content.concept: Portfolio evidence should demonstrate reasoning, iteration, user-centered decisions, and the final solution.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

scenarios.question: Which artifact best demonstrates how the original problem was understood?
Which artifact best demonstrates how the design evolved?
Which artifact best demonstrates interaction design?
Which artifact provides evidence that the design was evaluated?

activities.title: Future Roadmap Builder
activities.instruction: Connect project findings to meaningful future improvements and validation activities.

content.concept: A UX roadmap identifies future improvements, validation opportunities, and product extensions based on current evidence.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

items.label: Usability Finding
items.description: Users struggle to discover an important feature.

items.label: Design Improvement
items.description: Improve navigation visibility and information hierarchy.

items.label: Validation
items.description: Run another usability test to evaluate whether discoverability improves.

items.label: Product Extension
items.description: Consider related features only after validating the primary experience.

items.label: Success Metric
items.description: Measure feature discovery and task completion.

separation.learning: Teach the concept through an interactive experience.
separation.assessment: Stored separately and completed after learning.
separation.practical: Stored separately and completed after assessment.
